description: Make a Rust INI parser panic-free: replace the unwrap/expect calls in src/lib.rs with a ParseError enum (InvalidLine, MissingKey, BadNumber carrying the offending input), Result returns and map_err-based conversion, and document that parse() no longer panics, using only the standard library.

criteria: src/lib.rs declares a ParseError enum with InvalidLine, MissingKey and BadNumber variants carrying the offending input, derives the usual traits and implements Display/Error for it, returns Result<_, ParseError> from parse, parse_section, parse_pair, parse_number, get_text and get_number with map_err/ok_or converting every fallible step, documents that parse no longer panics, and contains no .unwrap() call, all with only the standard library and the README untouched.
